DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_departments`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_departments` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `code` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `parent_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  `sort_order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_department_code` (`code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_department_name` (`name`),
  KEY `idx_hr_departments_parent` (`parent_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_department_parent` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `hr_departments` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_department_not_own_parent` CHECK (((`parent_id` is null) or (`parent_id` <> `id`))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_department_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_department_sort_order` CHECK ((`sort_order` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_department_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'INACTIVE')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_employee_contacts`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_employee_contacts` (
  `employee_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `permanent_address` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_address` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `work_email` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `personal_email` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `emergency_contact_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `emergency_contact_phone` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `emergency_contact_relation` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`employee_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_contacts_phone` (`phone`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_contacts_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employees` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_contacts_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_employee_documents`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_employee_documents` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `employee_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `document_category` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `document_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `file_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `file_type` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `file_size_bytes` bigint NOT NULL,
  `file_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `file_data` longblob NOT NULL,
  `document_number` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `issue_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `expiry_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `issuing_authority` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `note` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employee_documents_emp_cat` (`employee_id`,`document_category`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employee_documents_emp_date` (`employee_id`,`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_employee_document_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employees` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employee_document_category` CHECK ((`document_category` in (_utf8mb4'CITIZEN_ID',_utf8mb4'CURRICULUM_VITAE',_utf8mb4'DEGREE_CERTIFICATE',_utf8mb4'HEALTH_CERTIFICATE',_utf8mb4'LABOR_CONTRACT',_utf8mb4'DECISION',_utf8mb4'OTHER'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employee_document_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;


DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_employee_employment`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_employee_employment` (
  `employee_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `department_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `working_condition_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `hire_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `leave_accrual_start_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `termination_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `contract_type_label` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `contract_number` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `base_salary` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `allowance` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `job_description` varchar(2000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`employee_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employment_department` (`department_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employment_position` (`position_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employment_condition` (`working_condition_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employment_hire_date` (`hire_date`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employment_contract` (`contract_number`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_employment_condition` FOREIGN KEY (`working_condition_id`) REFERENCES `hr_working_conditions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_employment_department` FOREIGN KEY (`department_id`) REFERENCES `hr_departments` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_employment_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employees` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_employment_position` FOREIGN KEY (`position_id`) REFERENCES `hr_positions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employment_allowance` CHECK (((`allowance` is null) or (`allowance` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employment_base_salary` CHECK (((`base_salary` is null) or (`base_salary` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employment_dates` CHECK (((`termination_date` is null) or (`hire_date` is null) or (`termination_date` >= `hire_date`))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employment_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_employee_identity`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_employee_identity` (
  `employee_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `legacy_identity_number` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `citizen_identity_number` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `issued_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `issued_place` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `verification_status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNVERIFIED',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`employee_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_identity_legacy_number` (`legacy_identity_number`),
  KEY `idx_hr_identity_citizen_number` (`citizen_identity_number`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_identity_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employees` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_identity_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_identity_verification` CHECK ((`verification_status` in (_utf8mb4'UNVERIFIED',_utf8mb4'VERIFIED',_utf8mb4'NEEDS_REVIEW')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_employee_insurance`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_employee_insurance` (
  `employee_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `social_insurance_number` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `health_insurance_number` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `valid_from` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `valid_until` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`employee_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_insurance_social_number` (`social_insurance_number`),
  KEY `idx_hr_insurance_health_number` (`health_insurance_number`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_insurance_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employees` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_insurance_dates` CHECK (((`valid_until` is null) or (`valid_from` is null) or (`valid_until` >= `valid_from`))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_insurance_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_insurance_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'UNKNOWN',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'INACTIVE',_utf8mb4'NEEDS_REVIEW')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_employee_leave_entitlements`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_employee_leave_entitlements` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `employee_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `leave_year` smallint NOT NULL,
  `manual_override_days` decimal(6,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `note` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_leave_entitlement_employee_year` (`employee_id`,`leave_year`),
  KEY `idx_hr_leave_entitlement_year` (`leave_year`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_leave_entitlement_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employees` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_leave_entitlement_manual_override` CHECK (((`manual_override_days` is null) or (`manual_override_days` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_leave_entitlement_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_leave_entitlement_year` CHECK ((`leave_year` >= 2000))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_employee_movements`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_employee_movements` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `employee_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `movement_type` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
  `effective_date` date NOT NULL,
  `from_department_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `to_department_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `from_position_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `to_position_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `from_working_condition_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `to_working_condition_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `from_employee_status` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `to_employee_status` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `decision_number` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `decision_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_kind` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `import_batch_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `idempotency_key` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `confirmed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `confirmed_by_actor` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancelled_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `cancelled_by_actor` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `correction_of_movement_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_movement_idempotency` (`idempotency_key`),
  KEY `fk_hr_movement_from_department` (`from_department_id`),
  KEY `fk_hr_movement_to_department` (`to_department_id`),
  KEY `fk_hr_movement_from_position` (`from_position_id`),
  KEY `fk_hr_movement_to_position` (`to_position_id`),
  KEY `fk_hr_movement_from_condition` (`from_working_condition_id`),
  KEY `fk_hr_movement_to_condition` (`to_working_condition_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_movement_employee_date` (`employee_id`,`effective_date`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_hr_movement_status_date_type` (`status`,`effective_date`,`movement_type`),
  KEY `idx_hr_movement_import_batch` (`import_batch_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_movement_correction_target` (`correction_of_movement_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_movement_correction_target` FOREIGN KEY (`correction_of_movement_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employee_movements` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_movement_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employees` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_movement_from_condition` FOREIGN KEY (`from_working_condition_id`) REFERENCES `hr_working_conditions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_movement_from_department` FOREIGN KEY (`from_department_id`) REFERENCES `hr_departments` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_movement_from_position` FOREIGN KEY (`from_position_id`) REFERENCES `hr_positions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_movement_import_batch` FOREIGN KEY (`import_batch_id`) REFERENCES `hr_excel_import_batches` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_movement_to_condition` FOREIGN KEY (`to_working_condition_id`) REFERENCES `hr_working_conditions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_movement_to_department` FOREIGN KEY (`to_department_id`) REFERENCES `hr_departments` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_movement_to_position` FOREIGN KEY (`to_position_id`) REFERENCES `hr_positions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_movement_activation` CHECK (((`movement_type` not in (_utf8mb4'INITIAL_LOAD',_utf8mb4'INCREASE',_utf8mb4'REHIRE')) or (`to_employee_status` = _utf8mb4'ACTIVE'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_movement_decrease` CHECK (((`movement_type` <> _utf8mb4'DECREASE') or ((`from_employee_status` = _utf8mb4'ACTIVE') and (`to_employee_status` = _utf8mb4'INACTIVE')))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_movement_from_status` CHECK (((`from_employee_status` is null) or (`from_employee_status` in (_utf8mb4'DRAFT',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'INACTIVE')))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_movement_lifecycle` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'DRAFT') and (`confirmed_at` is null) and (`confirmed_by_actor` is null) and (`cancelled_at` is null) and (`cancelled_by_actor` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'CONFIRMED') and (`confirmed_at` is not null) and (`confirmed_by_actor` is not null) and (`cancelled_at` is null) and (`cancelled_by_actor` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'CANCELLED') and (`cancelled_at` is not null) and (`cancelled_by_actor` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_movement_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_movement_source` CHECK ((`source_kind` in (_utf8mb4'BASELINE_IMPORT',_utf8mb4'EXCEL_IMPORT',_utf8mb4'MANUAL',_utf8mb4'SYSTEM'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_movement_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'DRAFT',_utf8mb4'CONFIRMED',_utf8mb4'CANCELLED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_movement_to_status` CHECK (((`to_employee_status` is null) or (`to_employee_status` in (_utf8mb4'DRAFT',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'INACTIVE')))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_movement_type` CHECK ((`movement_type` in (_utf8mb4'INITIAL_LOAD',_utf8mb4'INCREASE',_utf8mb4'DECREASE',_utf8mb4'TRANSFER',_utf8mb4'POSITION_CHANGE',_utf8mb4'WORKING_CONDITION_CHANGE',_utf8mb4'ADJUSTMENT',_utf8mb4'REHIRE')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_employees`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_employees` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `employee_code` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `full_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `gender` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN',
  `date_of_birth` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `ethnicity` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `religion` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `birth_place_original` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `birth_place_current` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `education_level` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `major` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `employment_status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
  `status_effective_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_import_batch_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `workforce_group` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LEGACY_UNKNOWN',
  `onboarding_source` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LEGACY',
  `onboarding_policy_version` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_employee_code` (`employee_code`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employees_status_code` (`employment_status`,`employee_code`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employees_full_name` (`full_name`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employees_source_batch` (`source_import_batch_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employees_workforce_status` (`workforce_group`,`employment_status`,`employee_code`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_employee_source_batch` FOREIGN KEY (`source_import_batch_id`) REFERENCES `hr_excel_import_batches` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employee_gender` CHECK ((`gender` in (_utf8mb4'MALE',_utf8mb4'FEMALE',_utf8mb4'OTHER',_utf8mb4'UNKNOWN'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employee_onboarding_policy` CHECK ((`onboarding_policy_version` >= 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employee_onboarding_source` CHECK ((`onboarding_source` in (_utf8mb4'PROBATION',_utf8mb4'DIRECT_GENERAL_LABOR',_utf8mb4'MANUAL',_utf8mb4'IMPORT',_utf8mb4'LEGACY'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employee_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employee_status` CHECK ((`employment_status` in (_utf8mb4'DRAFT',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'INACTIVE'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employee_workforce_group` CHECK ((`workforce_group` in (_utf8mb4'OFFICE',_utf8mb4'GENERAL_LABOR',_utf8mb4'LEGACY_UNKNOWN')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_employment_contract_documents`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_employment_contract_documents` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `employment_contract_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `workforce_group` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `template_file_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `template_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `generated_file_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `generated_file_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `generated_docx` mediumblob NOT NULL,
  `snapshot_payload` json NOT NULL,
  `generated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `generated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employment_contract_document_contract` (`employment_contract_id`,`generated_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_employment_contract_document_contract` FOREIGN KEY (`employment_contract_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employment_contracts` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employment_contract_document_group` CHECK ((`workforce_group` in (_utf8mb4'OFFICE',_utf8mb4'GENERAL_LABOR'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employment_contract_document_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;


DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_employment_contracts`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_employment_contracts` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `employee_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `source_probation_candidate_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `contract_type` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `contract_number` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `sign_date` date NOT NULL,
  `effective_from` date NOT NULL,
  `effective_until` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'READY',
  `idempotency_key` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `activated_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `activated_by_actor` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_employment_contract_number` (`contract_number`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_employment_contract_idempotency` (`idempotency_key`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employment_contract_employee_status` (`employee_id`,`status`,`effective_from`),
  KEY `idx_hr_employment_contract_probation` (`source_probation_candidate_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_employment_contract_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employees` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_employment_contract_probation` FOREIGN KEY (`source_probation_candidate_id`) REFERENCES `hr_probation_candidates` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employment_contract_activation` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'EFFECTIVE') and (`activated_at` is not null) and (`activated_by_actor` is not null)) or (`status` <> _utf8mb4'EFFECTIVE'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employment_contract_dates` CHECK ((((`contract_type` = _utf8mb4'FIXED_TERM_12_MONTHS') and (`effective_until` is not null) and (`effective_until` > `effective_from`)) or ((`contract_type` = _utf8mb4'INDEFINITE') and (`effective_until` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employment_contract_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employment_contract_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'READY',_utf8mb4'EFFECTIVE',_utf8mb4'VOIDED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_employment_contract_type` CHECK ((`contract_type` in (_utf8mb4'FIXED_TERM_12_MONTHS',_utf8mb4'INDEFINITE')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;


DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_excel_import_batches`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_excel_import_batches` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `template_version_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `import_type` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `source_file_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `file_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `file_size` bigint NOT NULL,
  `storage_key` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_sheet_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `attempt_number` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `source_period_year` smallint DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_period_month` tinyint DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UPLOADED',
  `total_rows` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `valid_rows` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `warning_rows` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `invalid_rows` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `imported_rows` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `issue_summary` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `confirmation_key` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `parsed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `validated_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `confirmed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `confirmed_by_actor` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `rolled_back_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `rolled_back_by_actor` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `payload_retention_until` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `payload_purged_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `payload_purged_by_actor` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_import_file_attempt` (`file_sha256`,`source_sheet_name`,`import_type`,`attempt_number`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_import_confirmation_key` (`confirmation_key`),
  KEY `fk_hr_import_template` (`template_version_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_import_status_created` (`status`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_hr_import_file_sha` (`file_sha256`),
  KEY `idx_hr_import_payload_retention` (`payload_purged_at`,`payload_retention_until`,`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_import_template` FOREIGN KEY (`template_version_id`) REFERENCES `hr_excel_template_versions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_attempt` CHECK ((`attempt_number` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_count_totals` CHECK (((((`valid_rows` + `warning_rows`) + `invalid_rows`) <= `total_rows`) and (`imported_rows` <= (`valid_rows` + `warning_rows`)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_counts` CHECK (((`total_rows` >= 0) and (`valid_rows` >= 0) and (`warning_rows` >= 0) and (`invalid_rows` >= 0) and (`imported_rows` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_file_size` CHECK ((`file_size` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_lifecycle` CHECK (((`status` = _utf8mb4'FAILED') or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'UPLOADED') and (`parsed_at` is null) and (`validated_at` is null) and (`confirmed_at` is null) and (`rolled_back_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'PARSED') and (`parsed_at` is not null) and (`validated_at` is null) and (`confirmed_at` is null) and (`rolled_back_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'VALIDATED') and (`parsed_at` is not null) and (`validated_at` is not null) and (`confirmed_at` is null) and (`rolled_back_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'CONFIRMED') and (`parsed_at` is not null) and (`validated_at` is not null) and (`confirmed_at` is not null) and (`confirmed_by_actor` is not null) and (`rolled_back_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'ROLLED_BACK') and (`confirmed_at` is not null) and (`confirmed_by_actor` is not null) and (`rolled_back_at` is not null) and (`rolled_back_by_actor` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_payload_purge_audit` CHECK ((((`payload_purged_at` is null) and (`payload_purged_by_actor` is null)) or ((`payload_purged_at` is not null) and (`payload_purged_by_actor` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_period_month` CHECK (((`source_period_month` is null) or (`source_period_month` between 1 and 12))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_period_year` CHECK (((`source_period_year` is null) or (`source_period_year` between 1900 and 2200))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'UPLOADED',_utf8mb4'PARSED',_utf8mb4'VALIDATED',_utf8mb4'CONFIRMED',_utf8mb4'FAILED',_utf8mb4'ROLLED_BACK'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_type` CHECK ((`import_type` in (_utf8mb4'BASELINE',_utf8mb4'INCREASE',_utf8mb4'DECREASE',_utf8mb4'ROSTER')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE `hr_excel_import_rows` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `batch_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `sheet_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `source_row_number` int NOT NULL,
  `employee_code_hint` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `row_status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `raw_payload` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `normalized_payload` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `payload_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `issue_codes` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `employee_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `movement_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_import_row` (`batch_id`,`sheet_name`,`source_row_number`),
  KEY `fk_hr_import_row_movement` (`movement_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_import_row_status` (`batch_id`,`row_status`,`source_row_number`),
  KEY `idx_hr_import_row_employee` (`employee_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_import_row_batch` FOREIGN KEY (`batch_id`) REFERENCES `hr_excel_import_batches` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_import_row_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employees` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_import_row_movement` FOREIGN KEY (`movement_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employee_movements` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_row_number` CHECK ((`source_row_number` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_import_row_status` CHECK ((`row_status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'VALID',_utf8mb4'WARNING',_utf8mb4'INVALID',_utf8mb4'IMPORTED',_utf8mb4'SKIPPED',_utf8mb4'ROLLED_BACK')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_excel_template_versions`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_excel_template_versions` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `template_key` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `version_code` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `schema_version` smallint NOT NULL,
  `file_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `file_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `sheet_contract` json NOT NULL,
  `contains_pii` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
  `effective_from` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `effective_until` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_template_key_version` (`template_key`,`version_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_template_file_sha` (`file_sha256`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_template_dates` CHECK (((`effective_until` is null) or (`effective_from` is null) or (`effective_until` >= `effective_from`))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_template_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_template_schema_version` CHECK ((`schema_version` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_template_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'DRAFT',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'RETIRED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_monthly_roster_items`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_monthly_roster_items` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `roster_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `employee_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `display_order` int NOT NULL,
  `department_display_order` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `employee_code` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `full_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `department_code` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `department_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position_code` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `working_condition_code` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `working_condition_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `employment_status` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `hire_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `termination_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `leave_days` decimal(6,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `inclusion_reason` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `source_movement_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `snapshot_schema_version` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `snapshot_payload` json NOT NULL,
  `payload_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_roster_item_employee` (`roster_id`,`employee_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_roster_item_code` (`roster_id`,`employee_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_roster_item_order` (`roster_id`,`display_order`),
  KEY `idx_hr_roster_item_employee` (`employee_id`,`roster_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_roster_item_movement` (`source_movement_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_roster_item_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employees` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_roster_item_movement` FOREIGN KEY (`source_movement_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employee_movements` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_roster_item_roster` FOREIGN KEY (`roster_id`) REFERENCES `hr_monthly_rosters` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_item_department_order` CHECK (((`department_display_order` is null) or (`department_display_order` > 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_item_display_order` CHECK ((`display_order` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_item_leave` CHECK (((`leave_days` is null) or (`leave_days` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_item_reason` CHECK ((`inclusion_reason` in (_utf8mb4'BASELINE',_utf8mb4'CARRIED_FORWARD',_utf8mb4'INCREASE',_utf8mb4'REHIRE',_utf8mb4'ADJUSTMENT'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_item_schema_version` CHECK ((`snapshot_schema_version` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_item_status` CHECK ((`employment_status` in (_utf8mb4'DRAFT',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'INACTIVE')))

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_monthly_rosters`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_monthly_rosters` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `period_start` date NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
  `source_roster_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_import_batch_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `snapshot_schema_version` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `item_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `roster_checksum` char(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `opened_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `opened_by_actor` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `closed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `closed_by_actor` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `exported_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `exported_by_actor` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_roster_period` (`period_start`),
  KEY `idx_hr_roster_source` (`source_roster_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_roster_import_batch` (`source_import_batch_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_roster_import_batch` FOREIGN KEY (`source_import_batch_id`) REFERENCES `hr_excel_import_batches` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_roster_source` FOREIGN KEY (`source_roster_id`) REFERENCES `hr_monthly_rosters` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_item_count` CHECK ((`item_count` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_lifecycle` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'DRAFT') and (`opened_at` is null) and (`closed_at` is null) and (`exported_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'OPEN') and (`opened_at` is not null) and (`opened_by_actor` is not null) and (`closed_at` is null) and (`exported_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'CLOSED') and (`opened_at` is not null) and (`opened_by_actor` is not null) and (`closed_at` is not null) and (`closed_by_actor` is not null) and (`exported_at` is null)) or ((`status` = _utf8mb4'EXPORTED') and (`closed_at` is not null) and (`closed_by_actor` is not null) and (`exported_at` is not null) and (`exported_by_actor` is not null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_not_own_source` CHECK (((`source_roster_id` is null) or (`source_roster_id` <> `id`))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_period_start` CHECK ((extract(day from `period_start`) = 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_schema_version` CHECK ((`snapshot_schema_version` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_roster_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'DRAFT',_utf8mb4'OPEN',_utf8mb4'CLOSED',_utf8mb4'EXPORTED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_probation_candidates`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_probation_candidates` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `candidate_code` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `full_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `candidate_title` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `gender` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN',
  `date_of_birth` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `birth_place` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `nationality` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Việt Nam',
  `citizen_id` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `citizen_id_issued_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `citizen_id_issued_place` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `permanent_address` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `department_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `working_condition_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `job_template_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `probation_contract_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `probation_start_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `probation_end_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `base_salary` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `salary_note` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `job_description` varchar(2000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `department_rule_note` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
  `status_reason` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `converted_employee_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `converted_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `converted_by_actor` varchar(320) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_probation_candidate_code` (`candidate_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_probation_candidate_converted_employee` (`converted_employee_id`),
  KEY `fk_hr_probation_candidate_position` (`position_id`),
  KEY `fk_hr_probation_candidate_condition` (`working_condition_id`),
  KEY `fk_hr_probation_candidate_template` (`job_template_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_probation_candidate_status_end` (`status`,`probation_end_date`),
  KEY `idx_hr_probation_candidate_name` (`full_name`),
  KEY `idx_hr_probation_candidate_department` (`department_id`,`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_probation_candidate_condition` FOREIGN KEY (`working_condition_id`) REFERENCES `hr_working_conditions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_probation_candidate_department` FOREIGN KEY (`department_id`) REFERENCES `hr_departments` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_probation_candidate_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`converted_employee_id`) REFERENCES `hr_employees` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_probation_candidate_position` FOREIGN KEY (`position_id`) REFERENCES `hr_positions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_probation_candidate_template` FOREIGN KEY (`job_template_id`) REFERENCES `hr_probation_job_templates` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_candidate_converted` CHECK ((((`status` = _utf8mb4'CONVERTED') and (`converted_employee_id` is not null) and (`converted_at` is not null) and (`converted_by_actor` is not null)) or ((`status` <> _utf8mb4'CONVERTED') and (`converted_employee_id` is null) and (`converted_at` is null) and (`converted_by_actor` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_candidate_dates` CHECK (((`probation_end_date` is null) or (`probation_start_date` is null) or (`probation_end_date` >= `probation_start_date`))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_candidate_gender` CHECK ((`gender` in (_utf8mb4'MALE',_utf8mb4'FEMALE',_utf8mb4'OTHER',_utf8mb4'UNKNOWN'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_candidate_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_candidate_salary` CHECK (((`base_salary` is null) or (`base_salary` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_candidate_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'DRAFT',_utf8mb4'CONTRACT_CREATED',_utf8mb4'IN_PROBATION',_utf8mb4'PASSED',_utf8mb4'FAILED',_utf8mb4'CONVERTED',_utf8mb4'CANCELLED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_probation_contracts`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_probation_contracts` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `candidate_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `contract_no` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `contract_year` smallint NOT NULL,
  `template_file_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `template_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `generated_file_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `generated_file_sha256` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `generated_docx` mediumblob NOT NULL,
  `snapshot_payload` json NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GENERATED',
  `generated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `generated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_probation_contract_no_year` (`contract_no`,`contract_year`),
  KEY `idx_hr_probation_contract_candidate` (`candidate_id`,`generated_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_probation_contract_candidate` FOREIGN KEY (`candidate_id`) REFERENCES `hr_probation_candidates` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_contract_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_contract_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'GENERATED',_utf8mb4'VOIDED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_contract_year` CHECK ((`contract_year` between 1900 and 2200))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_probation_job_templates`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_probation_job_templates` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `code` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `department_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `working_condition_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `probation_contract_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `job_description` varchar(2000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `base_salary` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `salary_note` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `department_rule_note` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  `sort_order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_probation_job_template_code` (`code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_probation_job_template_name` (`name`),
  KEY `fk_hr_probation_template_department` (`department_id`),
  KEY `fk_hr_probation_template_position` (`position_id`),
  KEY `fk_hr_probation_template_condition` (`working_condition_id`),
  KEY `idx_hr_probation_template_status_sort` (`status`,`sort_order`,`name`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_probation_template_condition` FOREIGN KEY (`working_condition_id`) REFERENCES `hr_working_conditions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_probation_template_department` FOREIGN KEY (`department_id`) REFERENCES `hr_departments` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_hr_probation_template_position` FOREIGN KEY (`position_id`) REFERENCES `hr_positions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_template_row_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_template_salary` CHECK (((`base_salary` is null) or (`base_salary` >= 0))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_template_sort_order` CHECK ((`sort_order` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_probation_template_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'INACTIVE')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `hr_working_conditions`;
CREATE TABLE `hr_working_conditions` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `code` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  `sort_order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `created_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_actor` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `row_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `annual_leave_days_base` decimal(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '12.00',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_working_condition_code` (`code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_hr_working_condition_name` (`name`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_working_condition_annual_leave_base` CHECK ((`annual_leave_days_base` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_working_condition_sort_order` CHECK ((`sort_order` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_working_condition_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'INACTIVE'))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_hr_working_condition_version` CHECK ((`row_version` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

  `id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_read` bit(1) NOT NULL,
  `message` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `priority` enum('HIGH','LOW','NORMAL') NOT NULL,
  `read_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_type` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `type` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `sender_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_notifications_recipient_source_type` (`user_id`,`type`,`source_type`,`source_id`),
  KEY `idx_notifications_recipient_read_created` (`user_id`,`is_read`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_notifications_recipient_created` (`user_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_notifications_source` (`source_type`,`source_id`),
  KEY `FK13vcnq3ukas06ho1yrbc5lrb5` (`sender_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `FK13vcnq3ukas06ho1yrbc5lrb5` FOREIGN KEY (`sender_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `FK9y21adhxn0ayjhfocscqox7bh` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `profile_update_requests`;
CREATE TABLE `profile_update_requests` (
  `id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `current_avatar_url` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_department_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_full_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `current_position` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `requested_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `requested_avatar_url` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `requested_full_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `requested_position` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `review_reason` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('APPROVED','PENDING','REJECTED') NOT NULL,
  `requested_department_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `requester_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `reviewed_by_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_profile_update_requests_status_requested` (`status`,`requested_at`),
  KEY `idx_profile_update_requests_requester` (`requester_id`,`status`),
  KEY `FKq7mhf2sljfgrd77awcdnlaxge` (`requested_department_id`),
  KEY `FKhm96spl79w8av5xmmfn1eic3n` (`reviewed_by_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `FK15dj3j9di3cb1cxukitqb4dpp` FOREIGN KEY (`requester_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `FKhm96spl79w8av5xmmfn1eic3n` FOREIGN KEY (`reviewed_by_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `FKq7mhf2sljfgrd77awcdnlaxge` FOREIGN KEY (`requested_department_id`) REFERENCES `departments` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `rooms`;
CREATE TABLE `rooms` (
  `id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `capacity` int NOT NULL,
  `equipment` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `image_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `location` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('ACTIVE','INACTIVE','MAINTENANCE') DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;
